According to the **Terms of Service** governing the `protonvpn.com` website and its services:
> *"By using the proton.me or protonvpn.com websites, making use of a Proton Account (the “Account”) and all its related features or otherwise using our services (with or without an Account) Proton Mail, Proton Calendar, Proton Drive, Proton VPN and Proton Pass... The Services are operated by Proton AG (“We”, the “Company”), a Swiss company located at Route de la Galaise 32, 1228 Plan-les-Ouates, Geneva, Switzerland..."*
